description: Task019B-E native adapter acceptance mapped to actual XCTest executable discovery. Automation existence is separate from revision-bound execution status. Twenty cases use real native input; selected disposable worker gates are explicit. Broad acceptance rows retain uncovered subcases; core/headless checks never substitute for native results.

cases.expected: Equivalent shortcuts, menus and controls use the shared dispatcher and produce equivalent tool, brush, history and file outcomes
Delayed save completion preserves unfinished native field text, caret, focus and text undo; corrected width affects freshly saved ink

gaps.reason: The field is empty when completion arrives; later caret insertion is tested, but preserving a pre-existing nonzero caret/selection across completion remains uncovered.

cases.expected: A delayed admitted save writes revision A while newer native drawing B stays dirty; next Save writes B
Save As preserves the old binding until acknowledgement, disables duplicate Save As and preserves the old destination on cancellation or failure

gaps.reason: Pending/failure cases verify title and old bytes, but ordinary Save during pending Save As or after its failure must prove the old destination remains the binding. Cancellation has this stronger oracle.

cases.expected: Real write failures retain edits and last-good bytes where applicable; durability warnings accurately report written data; retry is a fresh command

gaps.reason: Failure cases target new destinations. Failure while overwriting an existing destination must separately verify its last-good bytes remain intact.

cases.expected: Open observes previously accepted Save; corrupt or stale delayed reads cannot replace newer edits or change binding

gaps.reason: Native oversized/stale delayed-read journeys are not covered; service stale-read tests do not replace native delivery evidence.

cases.expected: New and Open honor Save, Cancel and Don't Save, outstanding writes and newer edits without premature replacement

gaps.reason: The suite covers pending-save cancellation and New Cancel/Discard. New Save and the Open Save/Cancel/Discard matrix still need native coverage.

cases.expected: Close and Quit defer accepted writes, preserve the app after cancellation or failure, and finish native termination exactly once

gaps.reason: Cmd-W, write-failure termination, and poisoned-engine native close/quit remain uncovered. Lower-level cleanup tests are separate evidence.

cases.expected: Late results from cancelled operations cannot present obsolete sheets, replace content, change title or steal focus

gaps.reason: The mapped case covers cancelled destination resolution. Late reads, obsolete failure sheets and closed-window callbacks need additional native journeys.

cases.expected: Later preserves recovery; opening a recovered copy uses unsaved navigation and creates visible dirty, unbound content

gaps.reason: Later and dirty/unbound recovered-copy opening are covered; opening over current unsaved edits with Save/Cancel/Discard needs native coverage.

cases.expected: Recovery fallback, capacity feedback and exact-candidate discard preserve newer or unselected recovery data

gaps.reason: Recovery capacity feedback and discard racing a newer candidate generation remain native coverage gaps.

cases.expected: Background work preserves focus; cancelled sheets restore only a valid responder; resize or deactivation cancels drafts before remapping

gaps.reason: Native resize/deactivation during a gesture and restoring the originating responder after cancelled sheets remain uncovered by these automated cases.
